subject: Media Technology Shop Profile
overview: Mr. Hester and students from Medford Vocational Technical High School provide an overview of the Media Technology program's curriculum and career prospects. The video highlights hands-on training in video production, editing, and broadcasting.

items.title: Program Overview and Technical Skills
items.summary: Mr. Hester introduces the Media Technology shop and describes the curriculum, which covers video and audio production, camera operation, and animation.

items.title: Student Perspectives on Media Production
items.summary: Students discuss their interests in news broadcasting, performance, and technical skills such as visual effects and editing.

items.title: Career Paths and Creative Projects
items.summary: Mr. Hester highlights the growing video industry job market, and Tucker discusses his social media segments and plans for college sports media studies.
